Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our long relationship and understand that your material costs have risen; your forward purchasing at fixed prices is also relevant context. Our full demand for this part over the contract term would be with you, with a rising forecast and the planning security of a long-term agreement, so please take this into account in your pricing. Your owner once offered to walk us through the calculation—could we review how the fixed-price material purchasing is reflected in the alloy surcharge and base price?

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We are pleased to offer a 36-month contract to support your planning, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause and maintain 30-day payment terms.
While company policy prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, our price basis reflects our forward purchasing at fixed prices, ensuring reliable supply for your rising demand.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.51 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing our data and for moving your proposal; we appreciate the effort. We understand that you have secured material at fixed prices and that the longer contract supports your planning as our forecasted demand rises. Our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all with you, and our proposal moves toward you again; the proposed terms follow after the data.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.82 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 90 days net, 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

You mentioned that your order volume is fixed; please provide the exact volume figures so we can review them.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
